_readme: S447 SkyBrittlebush, 2026-10-22. Santa Barbara City's Philosophy AA-T and Film, Television, and Electronic Media AS-T were never candidates for their own pages. Read as the capture does (run 39773199040, first filed with the Mt. San Jacinto pages in one plan): both pages keep their Requirements tab, and the state's file lists 130 and 193 courses for the two programs, far more than either page names, so the miss is the coverage share, not the reader. Two loads, no model call.

questions.capture_tabs: Which tab panels the capture keeps, and whether the Requirements tab names the program's listed courses.
